name: io.github.devtalh/backdraw
title: Backdraw
description: Generate images with your own ChatGPT account in a background Chrome tab. Needs Windows + Chrome.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.requirements: Windows 10/11, Google Chrome 116+, Node.js 20+, a ChatGPT account signed in in Chrome. Run "npx backdraw@latest setup" once to install the browser extension and native host.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.notice: Personal use with your own account. Automating the ChatGPT web page may conflict with OpenAI's terms; not affiliated with OpenAI or Anthropic.
